components.css: .ds-lamp-row{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-right:12px;font:400 12px 'Geist Variable',sans-serif;color:var(--muted-foreground)}.ds-lamp{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:9999px}.ds-lamp-danger{background:var(--destructive);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab,black 22%,transparent)}.ds-lamp-success{background:var(--success);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab,black 22%,transparent)}.ds-lamp-off{border:1px solid color-mix(in oklab,var(--muted-foreground) 70%,transparent)}

components.name: Dial Scale
components.description: The week as a tuning dial: overdue reading, day columns with ticks, one key-colored needle at now.
components.css: .ds-dial{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(84px,auto) minmax(0,1fr);background:var(--card);padding:16px 16px 12px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--border)}.ds-dial button{all:unset;cursor:pointer;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;border-radius:6px}.ds-dial-past{padding:6px 16px 2px 4px}.ds-day{padding:6px 4px 2px 10px}.ds-dial button:hover{background:var(--accent)}.ds-dial button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring);outline-offset:-2px}.ds-days{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.ds-needle{position:absolute;top:4px;bottom:0;left:0;width:2px;border-radius:1px;background:var(--primary);transform-origin:bottom;animation:ds-needle 600ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both}.ds-needle::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-3px;left:-3px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--primary)}@keyframes ds-needle{from{transform:scaleY(0.15)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-needle{animation:none}}.ds-num{display:block;font-family:'Geist Variable',sans-serif;font-weight:300;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-0.02em;color:var(--foreground)}.ds-num-lg{font-size:32px}.ds-num-sm{font-size:22px;height:24px}.ds-alarm{color:var(--destructive)}.ds-tick{height:12px;border-left:1px solid var(--muted-foreground)}.ds-leg{font:400 12px 'Geist Variable',sans-serif;color:var(--muted-foreground)}.ds-today{font-weight:600;color:var(--foreground)}

components.name: Readout
components.description: Live count for an active source: light tabular numeral over a lowercase lamp legend; 'set up' when not connected.
components.css: .ds-readouts{display:flex;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden}.ds-readout{all:unset;cursor:pointer;flex:1 1 132px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding:14px 20px 12px}.ds-readout+.ds-readout{border-left:1px solid var(--border)}.ds-readout:hover{background:var(--accent)}.ds-readout:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring);outline-offset:-2px}.ds-rnum{font:300 28px/1 'Geist Variable',sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:-0.02em;color:var(--foreground)}.ds-setup{font:500 14px 'Geist Variable',sans-serif;color:var(--foreground);text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:var(--muted-foreground);text-underline-offset:4px}.ds-rleg{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font:400 12px 'Geist Variable',sans-serif;text-transform:lowercase;color:var(--muted-foreground)}.ds-rlamp{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--muted-foreground);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab,black 22%,transparent)}.ds-rlamp-off{background:none;box-shadow:none;border:1px solid color-mix(in oklab,var(--muted-foreground) 70%,transparent)}

components.name: Attention Queue Row
components.description: Ranked queue row: lamp, source, mono identifier, title, due detail; hairline-separated, keyboard navigable.
components.css: .ds-queue{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden}.ds-queue li+li{border-top:1px solid color-mix(in oklab,var(--border) 70%,transparent)}.ds-qrow{all:unset;cursor:pointer;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:8px 3.25rem minmax(0,7.5rem) minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;column-gap:12px;padding:12px 16px;font-family:'Geist Variable',sans-serif}.ds-qrow:hover{background:var(--accent)}.ds-qrow:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring);outline-offset:-2px}.ds-qlamp{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--destructive);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab,black 22%,transparent)}.ds-qlamp-info{background:var(--info)}.ds-qsrc,.ds-qdet{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted-foreground)}.ds-qid{font:12px ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;color:var(--muted-foreground)}.ds-qtitle{font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--foreground);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.ds-qdue{font-size:12px;color:var(--destructive);text-align:right}.ds-qdet{text-align:right}

narrative.overview:
Astryn is built like one well-made appliance from the Rams-era Braun lineage: a darker matte body holding a lighter faceplate, and on that faceplate only what the owner needs to read. The body (tab strip and dock) and the faceplate (content, panels) differ by lightness alone, in the same hue. Hairlines divide the faceplate into zones; nothing at rest casts a shadow.

Color is a signal channel. One functional key, a signal yellow on the dark finishes and a deep ochre on the light ones, marks "now", selection and focus, and it is the same key in all four finishes. Every other hue reports state (success, warning, destructive, info, merged) or is data passed through from Linear. State is shown on round indicator lamps: a lit lamp reports something, an unlit ring means there is nothing to report. A screen with nothing wrong is almost colorless.

The system ships as four finishes of the same appliance sharing one token contract: Graphite (black finish, cool body, the default), Charcoal (brown-black, warm body), Paper (white lacquer faceplate in a warm grey body) and Stone (cool white faceplate in a brushed-aluminium body). The Dashboard is the first surface composed in this world. The other screens already inherit its tokens (the shared key, orange warning, body-tone chrome, flat dock) but keep their earlier composition until each is redesigned; do not read their card grids or 11px pills as the new world's composition. Gradients, glows, glass, backdrop blur and neon or purple-to-blue washes are confirmed rejections (PRODUCT.md brand commitments).
keyCharacteristics: Two-tone matte shell: darker body for chrome, lighter faceplate for content, stepped by lightness only.
One shared signal-yellow key per finish, reserved for now, selection and focus.
Hue means state; Linear workflow and label colors pass through as data.
Round indicator lamps for state: lit vs unlit ring.
Lowercase small-sans control labels; light-weight tabular display numerals.
One faceplate divided into zones by hairlines; no shadows at rest.

rules.name: The One Key Rule
rules.body: The yellow/ochre key appears only for "now", selection and focus (and the primary action it implies). It is the same key in every finish; never add a second accent hue or a per-finish accent.

rules.name: The Color Means State Rule
rules.body: A hue may appear only to report state (the five state tokens), to mark now/selection/focus (the key), or to render Linear-provided workflow-state and label colors. Never color an icon, tab or section by category.

rules.name: The Orange Warning Rule
rules.body: Warning stays orange (hue 52 to 60), clear of the key's hue (78 to 95), so a warning is never mistaken for "now".

rules.name: The Priority Mapping Rule
rules.body: Urgent = destructive, High = warning, Medium = info, Low and No priority = muted-foreground. The bar glyph fills in muted-foreground and turns destructive only for Urgent.

rules.name: The One Contract Rule
rules.body: Every finish defines the identical token set. Components reference roles (`bg-card`, `bg-sidebar`, `text-success`), never literal colors; a new finish is a new `[data-theme]` block and nothing else.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Text and state tokens hold at least 4.5:1 against background, card, body and muted in every finish; primary-foreground holds 4.5:1 on primary. A new or edited token must pass before it ships.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional text renders below 11px; redesigned surfaces hold 12px. Weight and color, not shrinking, create the quiet tier.

rules.name: The Light Numeral Rule
rules.body: A reading is a light (300), tabular numeral at 22, 28 or 32px. Never bold a number to make it important; color it destructive if it is an alarm.

rules.name: The Lowercase Legend Rule
rules.body: Control legends (labels under a reading, lamp names, day names) are lowercase small sans. Headings and titles stay sentence case.

rules.name: The No Shadow At Rest Rule
rules.body: If it is part of the layout, including the dock and tab strip, it has no shadow. Only transient overlays lift.

rules.name: The No Glass Rule
rules.body: No backdrop blur, translucency-as-material, gradients or glows on any surface, in any finish.

dos: Do reference role tokens (`background`, `card`, `sidebar`, `primary`, `success`...) so every component works in all four finishes unchanged.
Do put chrome on the body tone (`bg-sidebar`, `sidebar-accent`, `sidebar-border`) and content on the faceplate (`background`, `card`).
Do reserve the key for now, selection and focus; one needle, one active item.
Do report state with round lamps: lit in a state token, or an unlit ring when there is nothing to report.
Do set readings as light (300) tabular numerals at 22, 28 or 32px, with lowercase 12px legends.
Do divide a faceplate into zones with hairlines rather than stacking separate cards.
Do show "set up" instead of a number for a source that is on but not connected.
Do map priority as Urgent = destructive, High = warning, Medium = info, Low/None = muted-foreground.
Do render Linear workflow-state and label colors exactly as the API supplies them.
Do draw focus as a solid outline in the ring color so it survives forced-colors mode.
Do check any new or edited token for 4.5:1 text contrast on background, card, body and muted, and 3:1 for input strokes and the focus ring, in every finish.
donts: Don't use gradients, glows, glass, backdrop blur, neon accents or purple-to-blue washes.
Don't add a second accent hue or a per-finish accent; reach for a state token or for neutrals.
Don't let warning drift toward yellow; it stays orange.
Don't put shadows on resting panels, rows, the tab strip or the dock.
Don't color an icon, tab or section to tell categories apart.
Don't show a zero for a source that is not configured.
Don't set functional text below 11px, or below 12px on redesigned surfaces.
Don't hard-code a hex or a finish name inside a component.
